summary: HCW Biologics filed an 8-K for a securities purchase agreement with accredited investors, issuing 618,682 units at $2.585 per unit (shares or pre-funded warrants plus common warrants), raising about $1.6 million gross for working capital. Common warrants, exercisable at $2.585 for 5.5 years, require stockholder approval under Nasdaq rules. No advisor or board recommendation noted. Watch for stockholder approval and potential dilution impact.
